findings.problem: "we guarantee you'll love it or your money back" uses the banned word "guarantee" and promises a refund, contradicting Jafferjees' strict no-refund, exchange-only policy.
findings.fix: Remove the guarantee/money-back language entirely, or replace with exchange-safe phrasing that doesn't imply any refund.

findings.problem: The main CTA link still reads literally "[Button text](https://usa.jafferjees.com/collections/new-arrivals)" — the placeholder "Button text" was never replaced with real call-to-action copy, as required by .claude/rules/emails.md.
findings.fix: Replace "Button text" with real CTA copy, e.g. "Shop the new arrivals".

findings.problem: A second link (also still literally "[Button text](...)") points to the best-sellers collection, violating the .claude/rules/emails.md requirement of exactly one main link with no other links in the body, and also leaves the placeholder text unreplaced.
findings.fix: Delete this sentence and link entirely so only the single new-arrivals CTA remains.

findings.problem: Subject "Big Sale, Don't Miss Out" and preview "Huge savings... this week only" reference a sale/discount without the required live-site verification, and use manufactured urgency ("Don't Miss Out", "this week only") that brand/voice.md explicitly prohibits.
findings.fix: Verify any current promotion on the live site before referencing a sale; rewrite subject/preview in the warm, non-pushy heritage voice without artificial urgency.

findings.problem: Footer uses straight apostrophes ("You're", "you're") instead of the exact curly-apostrophe text ("You're", "you're") specified verbatim in .claude/rules/emails.md.
findings.fix: Replace straight apostrophes with curly apostrophes to match the required footer text exactly.
